answer: Require every identity to solve a fresh, epoch-bound proof tied to a unique hardware cipher key before it can earn. A farm cannot reuse one key across clones: each alias needs its own key, its own proof, and its own stake. The cost stacks like basalt layers - one identity is cheap, a thousand is a canyon of expense no farm can cross, because the proof expires each epoch and must be redone. Clones stop paying the moment each one carries its own full cost.
